guitar.notes: Tom Scholz is known for Gibson Les Pauls run through his own Rockman gear; fairly well known but not as singularly iconic as e.g. Slash's, so medium fits.

tone.target: bright layered Boston arena rock lead with smooth sustain
tone.profile: bright layered Boston arena rock lead with smooth sustain
tone.summary: A polished, layered signal chain utilizing a pre-amp boost for sustain, followed by an AC30 model, paired with chorus and delay to achieve the signature bright arena rock sheen of Boston.
corrections: use smooth sustain, not generic rock lead

rig.name: Boston - More Than A Feeling - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and sustain tail.
Provide smooth sustain and polish the signal before distortion.
blocks.gap: The Comp module is ideal for achieving the required 'smooth sustain' without sounding overly compressed or dirty.

blocks.purpose: Add the necessary grit and upper-mid punch characteristic of 80s arena rock leads.
blocks.gap: While a dedicated Tube Screamer model would be perfect, Green OD provides a similar bright, mid-focused boost/overdrive suitable for this genre.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, articulate sound of a classic Marshall-style British amp.
Provide the classic British rock tone and necessary upper-mid punch.
Add the required 'polished stereo sheen' and subtle chorus feel without sounding artificial.
Add subtle layering and depth to the sustained lead lines.
Provide the required 'short reverb' and sense of arena space.
blocks.gap: Plate or Spring could also work, but Room provides a more natural, polished ambient decay suitable for this genre.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and upper-mid definition for a more polished arena rock sheen.

proposals.reason: Enhance upper-mids and polish the sustained lead tone.
